These JSON files capture actual original money-owner definitions read from the
configured production Supabase connection on 2026-11-16. The native PG17 run
recreates them and verifies each PostgreSQL `pg_get_functiondef` MD5 before
installing prospective source. Captures contain source, no records or secrets.

The regression executes the original promo ticket send/batch refusal and old
receipt replay, the original ticket owner with cashable player/agent sources,
agent-source cancellation and replay, the actual wallet debit primitive,
per-entry principal, partial prizes/refunds, earned satellite rollover, full
loss and the private five-per-day Free Buy book. Actual original Free Buy
bounty/head and cutoff funding owners create source-ledger-backed coupon face
slices. Coupon allowance alone creates no grant; guarantee zero/fractional/large
subsidies and exact aggregate cents preserve the original funding formulas. Bought tickets never create
new promo custody or a new play-through target.

Fixture adapters are explicit: journal legs replace production autoledger and
tally, the registration wrapper calls the actual debit primitive, the actual fee migration prefix records immutable original entry funding
and prices its payable contract, and principal return records intent and retires
custody. The lock-only source-fund adapter has no real fund journal. This proof
does not qualify the production tally, full tournament entry accounting,
original exact-refund closure or source-fund concurrency; the combined owning
financial integration must qualify those before programme activation.

Free Buy escrow updates and guarantee-funding reads are explicit isolated
adapters. The actual original head/cutoff functions and their promo source
balance debit, immutable journal, replay keys and pool update run unchanged.
This is not a full production guarantee/escrow closure claim.

The native run loads the actual private inventory-pin owner captured by the
custody dependency, preserving its owner-only ACL. Union coupon principal
uses the original registration wallet club and survives lawful registration
deletion as immutable funding evidence.

The current purchase-owner capture preserves the original direct rebuy/reentry/
addon wallet debit and updates only its existing admission-body pin. The bust
capture retains the actual accepted-hand and complete-bounty-marker owners.
The narrow fixture compiles these definitions; actual monetary reentry and
source-fund returns require the full original financial closure proof.
Original expense receipts freeze entrant/earning club independently of refund
wallet destination and use the original financial transaction clock. Both
same-transaction fee/gift orders, true-zero funding, exact 4× completion,
partial/full canonical fee reversals and terminal loss before a later gift are
qualified without treating delayed commission recognition as the paid clock.

`bust-reentry.sql` runs the actual accepted-zero generation reentry after the
maintained bounty opening and current original entitlement/funding owners in
`entry-entitlement-owners.json`. The prior promo position is an explicit typed
opening. The new real-funded purchase, original bounty marker, exact response
replay, principal loss receipts and all financial journals/deferred guards are
actual. It proves own100→90 stays cashable after old P8 is definitively lost;
it does not claim a later prize or rakeback payment witness.

`bust-money-owners.json` retains the five actual original reentry/bounty owner
definitions read on November16, with source hashes and no account records.
The full closure loads these preimages before applying the maintained source
patches, preserving the patched admission owner instead of replacing it later.

Original earning-generation qualification (200638)

`generation-owners.json` and `generation-nonwallet-owners.json` are read-only November16 production `pg_get_functiondef` captures. `generation-admission-guard.json` is the actual November17 post-winnings and returned-ticket admission contract (MD5 `4c7b1878f602c36a07a5951f09407931`), with its private ACL and configuration. Their MD5 fields fingerprint the complete function definition, not `prosrc`. They contain definitions only, no account rows or credentials. The prospective source patches preserve the original money, auth, price, idempotency and terminal gates; only original earning metadata and the exact changed reentry, public PKO and obligation-credit body pins are added.

`test-promo-tournament-earning-generation.py` installs the actual200638 migration into PostgreSQL17 with typed financial openings. It proves exact entry generation, original accepted-hand charge prefixes, old owed bounty versus a new own-funded entry, later addons, partial and mixed-generation owed ranges, bought/earned PKO head components, residual ranges, actual noncash award recipient/ledger linkage, legacy compatibility, replay and private ACLs. Captured original money owners are compiled and their patch anchors and body pins checked. The real protected stale-pin guard refuses the former omitted obligation-credit pin atomically, then accepts the corrected migration; whole-contract comparison permits exactly those three pin changes. The harness deliberately uses `check_function_bodies=off` for those surrounding captured owners because it does not install their full HS schema. It executes the actual new metadata helpers; it does not claim a real wallet journal, terminal payer or W allocation proof. Those remain in the existing full-financial and W composition lanes. No production writes are performed.

`generation-public-financial.sql` is the portable public-payer case, qualified with the existing `test-promo-principal-returns.py` bootstrap (maintained `test-promo-tournament-earning-financial.py`, invoked unconditionally by the existing generation entrypoint). Load actual generation owner captures plus current `log_wallet_transaction`/credit recorder, original source registry configuration from `generation-money-registry.json`, actual FreeBuy slice table DDL and200638 before the opening. Public PKO and mystery payout plus fresh purchases execute under all31 real financial triggers/35 original pinned owners;18 assertions plus deferred guards pass. The initial accepted-hand timing/complete roster and bought-head sources are explicit typed openings. No new financial adapter or W allocation proof is claimed. Captured public payers inline the financial bodies; retired `_unguarded` copies remain unchanged.

The maintained generation entrypoint runs the metadata checks first, stops that isolated cluster, then runs the public financial case under `--output/public-financial`. The financial runner reuses the existing returns script bootstrap through its unique original bust-seed boundary and refuses if that boundary or dependency is missing. It hashes the actual bootstrap, captures, registry, SQL case and producer source. `--financial-root` is only an explicit local dependency checkout override while composing the coherent bundle; CI defaults to its own repository. There is no metadata-only success option.

The joined public proof installs full H161707 and full W190221 through the real stale-pin installer guard before full generation200638. The existing PKO winner has an explicit prior P1/risk1 source opening; the actual public 2.5 payout must retain P1 and W1.5, and its original response replay must not mint W again. This proves the public earning/ledger/consumer join under all original journals; it does not claim the typed historical opening is a newly executed original admission. `--profit-root` is a local coherent-source override and defaults to the CI checkout.

`generation-terminal-cash-refund.sql` is executed by the same maintained financial entrypoint. From an explicit already-funded terminal entry20 and prior authorized refund liability, actual fee consumption spends2 and the actual terminal cleanup emits immutable loss18, closes the original grant permanently and exposes18 in the unified original loss basis. The original post-COMPLETED cash refund must refuse at the immutable wallet-credit-key guard; wallet, fund, journal, tranche, authorization, refund liability and grant snapshots remain identical. This is safe-refusal proof, not a positive postterminal fund-return claim. Existing preterminal/bust refund cases cover lawful positive returns.

`refunded-entry-keeps-promo.sql` is executed by the same maintained financial entrypoint after the terminal refusal case. From an explicit already-funded REGISTERING entry20 funded by a 20 promo grant, actual fee consumption spends2 and the original exact cash refund pays20. Migration `20261123000232` keeps all 20 with the member: 18 realized into wallet custody and the spent fee2 restored onto the same open grant, the fund unchanged, cashable still the member's own10, one restore receipt and no fund receipt, with replay of the refund owner moving nothing. The opening is typed; the refund, restore, journals and deferred guards are actual on the full custody, integrity and profit stack.
